title: Original entity dependency providers and physical census

sources.role: Official common graphical-entity reference roles; layer8 and owner330, optional linetype6 with BYLAYER omission and BYBLOCK inheritance, application/reactor/extension-dictionary scopes, material347 and plot390 pointers. Existing original profile classifiers remain prerequisites.

scope: Extend bounded original dependency coverage from TABLE/resource bodies to actual previously validated ENTITIES/BLOCKS entity producers. POINT/LINE, compound parents/children, ATTDEF and block boundaries now contribute their own source reference fields. Census every physical entity so dropped/unsupported/unqualified sources cannot disappear from a matched result. Selected original source reference facts remain separate from full recursive/owner/live/emitted/native or external qualification.

implementation.sourceAdmission: Only Matched immutable EntitiesRoleAudit or BlockRoleAudit rows with actual original body/profile providers. Reuse primary/compound/ATTDEF profiles and original block-boundary raw profiles; bind original self/owner to producer-role rows. No cloned live models, synthetic table entries, callback changes or inferred producers.
implementation.pinning: Nodes pin actual entity/block role audit owners and row indexes. Queries verify those exact roots through the existing target audit and existing source/body/context-owner checks; copies, no-op aliases and body substitutions are refused.
implementation.physicalCensus: All identity Kind::Entity rows must have an actual matching physical entity provider. Unsupported raw entities remain readable but unavailable for dependency qualification.
implementation.referenceInventory: Reuse existing independent profile role translation for common/specialized fields, reactors, extension dictionaries, symbol names and XDATA. Original ENTITY linetype BYLAYER/BYBLOCK and omitted6 retain inherited dispositions; mandatory layer remains required. TABLE geometry coupling and earlier refusal reasons remain intact.
implementation.originalEntityOwners: Retain original owner role values separately from table-record models for effective hard-owner reverse checks. This is not whole-document ownership qualification.
implementation.bounds: Precharge entity and block source retention/group inventories, larger private nodes and reserved rows before scans. Reuse immutable producer/body owners. Per-node original reference counts are accumulated at finalization to keep report inspection allocation-free without row-by-row map lookups.

forms: unchanged Unicode layer spelling through DXF escapes with BYBLOCK linetype
inherited linetype plus entity-owned extension dictionary and owned XRECORD
otherCases: unsupported raw entity in physical census

development.red: Ordinary import succeeds with a validated POINT701 source whose layer name is missing, but the old audit still reports originalTargetsMatched. Its original source fields were not included in the dependency pass.
development.initialOwningChecks: New red flips to refusal; prior dependency selector still passes with broader entity node coverage. Expanded new selector passes in3.57s before final exact-count assertions, which are verified in final affected cohorts.
retainedFailures: Original red test fails as intended.
Expanded test compile failed -Werror misleading-indentation at a multi-line if followed by a counter increment. Split statements; warning policy unchanged.

next: Complete remaining original producer/field/reference families, including other entity types, LAYOUT own references, material/visual-style/reactor/IMAGE/document/control/owner bodies, omitted dictionary flags and HEADER CEPSNID/CEPSNTYPE.

Complete full recursive/coupled dependencies, whole-document ownership, TABLE/linked metadata, native name/collation and required/absent/null/default semantics. Selected existing entity profiles and physical census do not qualify all entity types or graphical content.
Complete live/edited/emitted dependencies, handle remapping, exact output/readback, rollback/retry/destination safety, TABLE Value/multiple-content/linked-data/format/units/border output.
Retain full B2b/B3/C, native bit/decimal/carrier/schema/owner, version/corpus, measured memory/performance, source-release and LibreCAD/LibreCAD_3/dwg2dxf/FreeCAD qualification requirements.

Keep fast owning checks, affected integration, frozen compiled sources, ordered normal/ASan runtimes, retained failures and per-slice plan updates/commits; no external drawing payloads, conversions or derivatives.

validation.scope: Affected integration cohort, not a full suite, formal ABI/native application or measured memory/performance qualification.
